clauses.requirement: Parking lamps (77R): the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility shall meet the values given in Table 5 of UN R148.
Parking lamps (77R): there are no requirements for the minimum or maximum area of the apparent surface.
Parking lamps (77R): for front and rear parking lamps, the standard light distribution may, at the request of the applicant, be considered from the VV line to the outboard only when measuring.
Parking lamps (77R): no additional specific requirements apply.
Parking lamps (77R): the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6 of UN R148 shall be met.
Parking lamps (77R): the colour of the emitted light shall be white for front parking lamps and red for rear parking lamps.
Daytime running lamps (RL): the specific technical requirements of paragraph 5.4 of UN R148 apply to this lamp function; this heading applies only if a daytime running lamp function is fitted.
Daytime running lamps (RL): the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the luminous intensity and standard light distribution requirements in Table 6 of UN R148.
